name: Classic Fish Pie with Peas and Mashed Potato Crust

components.name: Fish Pie

ingredients.name: Raw boneless white fish in large cubes
Raw boneless smoked fish (check source and salt)

steps: Peel and boil potatoes until soft, drain well, then mash with butter, milk and cheese. Keep warm while preparing filling.
In another large saucepan, briefly cook diced onion in butter; add flour and gradually whisk in milk and stock until a thick smooth sauce forms.
Stir through mustard, parsley and peas, then gently fold in cubed raw fresh and smoked fish without breaking the pieces.
Place the fish mixture in a large baking dish; spread the mashed potatoes across the top, sealing to the edges.
Bake at 200 C for around 30-40 minutes until centre of the fish reaches 63 C and mash browns.
Stand at least 10 minutes before cutting into eight squares. Cool promptly before packing or freezing.
